coverage.remaining: Nothing: every meeting in the scan for the year was read.
coverage.note: 1990-01-03 to 1990-12-19. Read whole, first meeting to last: 33 regular meetings (January 3 to December 19, 1990) plus 3 special site-inspection meetings printed as SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD (February 20 at 27 Shoreview Avenue, August 17 at 3121-23 Steiner Street, September 5 at 307 Mangels Avenue). The April 4 meeting included a 1:30 p.m. executive (closed) session on litigation; no June 13, 1990 meeting appears in the volume. Scan quirks: the OCR double-spaces nearly every word; the October 3 meeting header is garbled and the scan duplicates the pages carrying items 9B, 9C and 10, which were recorded once; penalty action text is scrambled in the OCR in several meetings and was reconstructed from the printed figures. Conflicts recorded as printed, never reconciled: the 842 Peru Street application number is 89066255 in the October 17 minutes and 8906255 in the October 24 and November 7 minutes; Appeal 90-238 prints the regular fee as $163.60 in the first motion and $163.80 in the second; Appeal 90-025 prints application no. 8921370 on February 21 and 89121370 on March 7; Sutter Street addresses vary between 2154-58, 2154 and 2154-2158; the March 14 jurisdiction vote for 54-56 Elizabeth Street is printed as 1-1 with the President absent and two commissioners noted dissenting, which does not reconcile; April 25 jurisdiction dates for 786-27th Street are printed as December 13/28, 1990, evidently 1989; Appeal 90-121 was continued September 26 to October 17 but does not appear in the October 17 or October 24 minutes and was next heard November 7; Appeal 90-143 was continued August 29 to October 24 but does not appear in the October 24, November 7, November 14 or November 28 minutes and was next heard December 19; Appeal 90-084 was continued May 30 to August 1 but never reappears in the volume. Skips of note: Appeal 90-090 (May 30) was not recorded because the minutes print a motion but no vote count; Appeal 88-154 (May 9) was a Superior Court remand and was skipped as a court outcome; taxicab, pedicab, driver-vehicle, pushcart and street-artist appeals and appeals about permits revoked or denied because of alleged criminal conduct were skipped entirely, as were requests to take jurisdiction that were granted, which are procedural. Open threads into 1991: Appeal 90-121 continued to January 9, 1991; Appeal 90-189 (El Tapatio, 4742 Mission Street) and Appeal 90-101 (pedicab) continued to January 16, 1991; Appeal 90-143 and Appeal 90-234 (taxicab public convenience and necessity) contin
